figures.finding: From 1 January 2026 monthly income is taxed at 0% to MK 170,000, 30% to MK 1,570,000, 35% to MK 10,000,000 and 40% above (Taxation (Amendment) Act No. 36 of 2025).
figures.applies: 2026; the MRA site serves no text to this environment, so a payroll publisher quoting the MRA is cited.

figures.finding: VAT is 17.5%, and a business registers once its taxable supplies reach K50,000,000 a year.

sources.said: Output tax is the VAT charged on sales, services or supplies at the applicable tax rates (17.5% or 0%). ... Section 11 of the VAT Act establishes the threshold for registration, that is, K50,000,000 per annum. Businesses or persons providing taxable supplies ... whose annual business turnover equals, exceeds or is expected to exceed K50,000,000 ... must register for VAT, within thirty (30) days
